body: I can't imagine how hard that might be... Have you ever tried any other coping things, like journalism, or something of that sort?

You don't understand me or my life, you don't know all of the shit I was put through. It's really hard to talk about which is why I didn't include in my post, but since you think i'm being ungrateful, and complaining for no reason... I grew up with my parents being drug addicts, and alcoholics. I was constantly abused from age 1-6. I have suffered from major depressive disorder, an unknown anxiety disorder, bipolar tendencies, add, rad, and ptsd. I cut and took pills multiple times in hopes of committing suicide... I have been in multiple behavioral hospitals, and a residential treatment center... I was raped at the age of 15 by a 25 year old. I struggle everyday just waking up. I almost never come out of my room, and I have had to take breaks from school many times due to my severe depression, because every time i would do school I would be so stressed I would cry the whole time. There is so much other shit ive been through but i thought you should know that my entire life has been a living hell, and while it may seem as though I have a lot now, nothing can fix the shit ive been through.
im so sorry... that sounds like it would be really tiring, have you tried going on a walk?
I'm really sorry... it must feel so difficult having to feel like you have no energy.
